summary: Tested the new leave-balance APIs/calculation, 20 intermediate MCQs, admin glass dashboard, teacher leave card, and secretary RH UI. Backend passed 8/8 tests. Admin and teacher UI flows passed. Secretary RH works after a reload, but code-login initially redirects users to the generic login page.

integration_issues.issue: POST /api/auth/secretary-login succeeds and stores token/user, but navigating to /secretary is immediately redirected to /login. A direct reload of /secretary then works.
The notification WebSocket closed before establishing through the public preview URL; this is a previously documented ingress limitation and did not block the leave card.

action_items: Fix SecretaryLogin to update AuthProvider state before navigating (for example, add/use a context session-login method or await checkAuth); do not rely only on localStorage.
Retest secretary code login without a reload, then verify the RH tab still loads employee balances.
Confirm the intended annual leave policy: current logic reaches a lifetime cap of 30 and never starts a new accrual year.
critical_code_review_comments: SecretaryLogin writes localStorage directly while ProtectedRoute reads AuthProvider.user; the stale null context causes the reproduced redirect to /login.
routes/auth.py defaults SECRETARY_LOGIN_CODE to the production-like code in source instead of failing fast on a missing environment variable.
Leave accrual is based on all months since account creation and permanently capped at 30; if 'max 30 days/year' requires a new entitlement each leave year, employees stop accruing after month 12.
AdminDashboard.js and TeacherDashboard.js fail static analysis: fetchStudents is undefined in create/import callbacks, and documentData/setDocumentData are undefined in teacher document handlers.
GiftWelcomeLetter renders <style jsx>, producing a React non-boolean DOM attribute console error on first teacher login.
AdminDashboard.js, SecretaryDashboard.js, TeacherDashboard.js, admin.py, and teacher.py exceed the 700-line maintainability guideline and should be split into focused modules.
LeaveBalanceCard silently returns null after API failure and provides no user-visible error or retry state.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all requested dashboard content passed; secretary code-login transition failed)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_ teacher accounts for teacher API/UI validation; all were soft-deleted, purged, and associated leave-balance/welcome-letter artifacts removed.
test_credentials: Required /app/memory/test_credentials.md was missing. Used admin/secretary credentials supplied in the review request; generated isolated teacher credentials through the admin API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend leave tests are in test_leave_balance_features.py and pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reproduce secretary login by clearing localStorage, submitting secretaire2025 at /secretary-login, and observing redirect to /login; manually loading /secretary then exposes the fully working RH tab (5 employees during this run).
rca_of_the_issue: SecretaryLogin.handleSubmit stores token/user directly in localStorage and calls navigate('/secretary') without updating AuthProvider.user. ProtectedRoute evaluates the still-null context and redirects to /login. A full page load reconstructs AuthProvider from localStorage, which explains why the workaround succeeds.
